arguments.prompt: Interior, a mayor's ornate office. A man in an immaculate dark navy suit stands at the tall French window with his back three-quarters to the camera, looking down into the square below; he is almost perfectly still - a slow breath, a slight shift of weight, the fingers of one hand closing at his side. The camera is locked off on a tripod and does not move at all: no pan, no tilt, no zoom, no drift, no handheld shake. Real-time speed, natural human movement, never slow motion. Tungsten desk lamp warm in the foreground, flat winter daylight through the glass, the giant limestone columns just outside the window fixed. Nothing else in the room moves. Prestige political drama photographed on an Arri Alexa with anamorphic lenses: single-source natural light, slight 35mm film grain, colours desaturated about twelve percent, warm tungstens, deep browns and charcoals in the shadows, photographic realism.
